tests.name: Quick Check
tests.description: Timed check on Devising Process and Stimulus

questions.question: Describe the process you would use to develop a piece of drama from a stimulus. Use a specific example.
questions.correctAnswer: Full process: receive stimulus → initial reactions → research → brainstorm → improvise → select strongest ideas → structure → rehearse → refine. Give a specific stimulus example showing each stage.

questions.question: How can research enhance a devised piece? What types of research might you do?
questions.correctAnswer: Research adds depth and authenticity: factual research (statistics, history), personal research (interviews, experiences), artistic research (other plays, art works). It prevents cliches and enriches content.

questions.question: Explain how collaborative devising is different from working with a script. What are the challenges and benefits?
questions.correctAnswer: Collaborative: everyone contributes ideas, ownership is shared, multiple perspectives enrich the work. Challenges: compromise, conflicting visions, unequal contribution. Benefits: creativity, investment, diverse ideas.
